answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake and earn attestations from established peers before it can trade at full trust. A newcomer starts as a lone ember: no history, no attestations, strict limits. Each verified job adds an edge, and only an identity that grows into a well-connected vertex — many independent attestors with stake at risk — gains full limits. A harbor of reputable agents may vouch for newcomers, but if a vouched identity proves fake, the harbor's stake is slashed, so every fake identity costs real money and burns real reputation.
